title: 270. Valid Number

examples.explanation: A single digit is a valid integer.
An exponent marker alone has no base digits and no exponent digits.
Base 2 followed by exponent 10 is well formed.

hints: Trim surrounding spaces first; spaces anywhere else make the string invalid.
Split on e/E: the exponent must be a signed integer and the base must be a signed decimal with at least one digit.
The base allows at most one dot and requires a digit on at least one side of it.
